headline: HQ reporting restored; next decision is a small real-host pilot.
summary: Owner clarification on September 14: the original prompt is a starting point, not a fixed rulebook. The team owns judgment and can revise targets, tactics, offer and agent allocation as evidence changes. Autonomous responsibility does not require continuous agent activity. HQ should explain what we learned, what changed and what we test next; reserve owner cards for concrete prepared actions requiring business authority.

Measured baseline is incomplete. A September 14 aggregate read of a locally configured database found 111 account rows, no registrations in the last 30 days, no upcoming published sessions in the next seven days and no recorded attended reflections. That connection is not verified as production and test/staff exclusions are unavailable. These are not 111 real users. Current production users, active supply and settled revenue remain unknown.

Initial planning scenarios are preserved for comparison: 25 new registrations by September 21; 200 base / 1,000 stretch by October 14. These are revisable assumptions, not fixed commitments or permission to buy empty growth. The dates become evidence-review checkpoints. No measured channel or verified production baseline supports a growth forecast yet. Set acquisition scale from real host capacity and compatible places; report missed assumptions and revisions openly.

Current business hypothesis: help a small real group attend something worthwhile, choose to return, and eventually make a voluntary settled payment for an implemented optional benefit at an owner-approved price. One payment would be an early signal, not proof of profitability. Existing Plus is a candidate offer that can be changed or rejected. Purchase intent is not revenue; no spending, pricing or payment activation is newly authorized.

Owner redeployment is Ready and serves keepitup.social: deployment dpl_5S6b4bLUCVAspaWZHrYJDnE8SArC, source commit 7fe07ad31a4c86fb1fd741dde1989dd3f2d307e7. The replacement social-agent key authenticated successfully to live HQ decisions and is now enabled in ignored local configuration. Access restoration is resolved; no owner decision was fabricated. Later reviewed application and framework changes are still local.

Completed a bounded dependency exposure review instead of assuming the 26 remaining npm findings require another broad upgrade. Fresh registry audit: 0 critical, 11 high, 15 moderate package findings. Tool returned exit 1 for findings, not a network failure. Image-size/Metro, PostCSS, js-yaml, fast-uri, xmldom and Vitest map to build/test tooling in reviewed paths. Undici 6.27.0 is runtime-reachable through Vercel Blob photo storage. Maintainer guidance and installed call sites did not establish an applicable exploit path: Blob uses fetch, not the advisory-specific duck-typed dispatcher path; no retry interceptor/cookie helper use found. This is bounded triage, not proof of safety. No dependency or product changes made.

Changed assumption: continuing small local improvements is no longer the best next use of a cycle after the concrete join/discovery repairs. No fresh customer evidence or additional verified core-flow blocker emerged. The host inquiry/session checklist is already prepared. Further interface work, repeated research or broad build-tool upgrades would not resolve the dominant commercial uncertainty. Defer speculative work; retain remaining dependency findings for evidence-triggered review.

Next evidence: owner executes the exact host-pilot card after approval, producing a real host commitment with format/date/capacity/responsibility, then worthwhile attendance and return. Establish deployment identity plus staff/test exclusions before calling aggregate account rows traction. An unsent inquiry is blocked execution, not channel failure. Preserve September 21/October 14 checkpoints and prior scenarios; no missed target is reset. Optional paid value follows actual usage and separate owner-approved pricing/payment scope.

Latest autonomous cycle completed at commit 795717483c226b61ed8cbf8d920c029ddd539f6f. Independent supervisor passed workspace typechecks, workspace tests, lint and the web production build. Runtime is owner-blocked after useful bounded work, awaiting changed evidence or scoped owner decisions. Deployment readiness and HQ authentication are verified; the rotated cron and Redis credentials still require runtime confirmation. No cleanup or reminder job was manually triggered.

HQ reporting access is restored. Remaining owner cards are the prepared host-validation pilot and exact reviewed application release. Current production source is 7fe07ad; redeploying it did not ship the later HQ/framework patch or isolated join/discovery work. Do not expand features merely to keep agents occupied. Establish real host supply and a verified production baseline next; no outreach, spending or new production application release has been performed by the team.

directions.title: Approve a small Bucharest host-validation pilot
directions.detail: Prepared packet in the reviewed local release: /operations/host-pilot-2026-09-14.html. Its public availability depends on the separate release card. Five organizations were checked on their official sites: Runners of Bucharest, F45 Bucharest North, Padel One, PadelMania and Bucharest Running Club. The packet contains the exact Romanian message, tailored opening lines and host/session checklist. No messages have been sent and no host is committed. This is a 14-day research pilot, not a final launch-country decision.
directions.recommendation: Approve Bucharest as the pilot hypothesis and personally send one tailored inquiry to each of the five organizations, with at most one follow-up after five business days if unanswered. Target five inquiries by day 3, two substantive conversations by day 7, one committed host and feasible session plan by day 14. A named real safety/operator contact is required before any session. Alternatives: name a city where you have a reliable local operator, or defer real outreach. Approval does not permit spending, bookings, contracts, public campaigns or agent-operated account messages.

directions.title: Approve the verified landing, HQ and framework-patch release
directions.detail: Exact reviewed application scope: d58c0e5 (including approved landing 7fe07ad, HQ freshness/decisions, host-pilot page and aggregate landing signal) plus dependency patch 98ac494 (Next/eslint-config-next 16.3.5 and lockfile). Team will verify the deployment diff against d58c0e5 plus 98ac494, excluding unrelated later application changes. No database migration, billing activation, outreach or spending is included. Alternative: keep it local for review. This is not blanket future deployment authority.
